title: Editing, mixing: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

A mixing session for Wings’ ‘Goodnight Tonight’ single took place on 29 January 1979.

Paul McCartney began the session by editing the song from 7:16 to 4:19. He then mixed both versions in stereo.

The day’s work was not considered good enough to release, however, and ‘Goodnight Tonight’ was mixed again on 30 January, 1, 5, 8, and 9 February, and 2 March 1979.

Page last updated: 30 January 2026
